name: dashboards
description: Living dashboards: pages of prompt-driven cards (KPIs, tables, lists, charts, text) over your drive files, with per-card runs, version history and full AI tooling.
help: Dashboards are pages of cards — KPIs, tables, lists, charts and text — that live on your drives like files: they are indexed, searchable and keep a full version history.
Each card carries a natural-language prompt plus references to files attached to the dashboard. Running a card executes the prompt and snapshots the result, so the page reads instantly.
Files are attached to the dashboard itself — either uploaded into the dashboard's folder or linked from your drives — and cards reference attachments by id.
